subject: Design Notes Weekly #214: variable fonts, view transitions, and a very good cursor
snippet: This week: a deep dive on variable font axes, a practical guide to view transitions, and a roundup of the best custom cursors on the web.
bodyText:
Hello, designer!

Issue #214 is here. This week we look at variable font axes and how to use them without wrecking performance, walk through view transitions with real examples, and round up the best custom cursors we saw on the web.

Read the full issue on the site.

Until next week,
The Design Notes crew
